target: 586 Rodens

source: 586 Gnawing
target: 586 Rodens

source: Ultraman Lato Guiaro, his life rapidly slipping away, fell into a daze.
target: Ultraman Lato Guiaro, vitae suae celeriter evanescente, in stuporem cecidit.

source: Even his thoughts of self-preservation became blurred.
target: Etiam cogitationes salutis suae obscuratae sunt.

source: In the haze, he vaguely saw Juan Oro, the wrinkled old man, standing in the middle of the sea, waving with a mix of joy and mockery.
target: In nebula, vix vidit Juan Oro, senex rugosus, in medio maris stantem, qui gaudio et derisio simul salutabat.

source: At that moment, Lumian’s voice resonated from the horizon, faint, ethereal, and elusive.
target: Illo momento, vox Lumiani a horizonte resonavit, tenuis, aetheria, et elusiva.

source: “Did you go to Cordu Village to confirm the situation?”
target: “An in vicum Cordu ivisti ad rem comprobandam?”

source: Cordu Village?
target: Vicus Cordu?

source: The time Mad Lady and I visited Nolfi, and went there just out of convenience?
target: Tempore quo Mad Lady et ego Nolfi visitavimus, et eo tantum ex commoditate iverimus?

source: Lato Guiaro lost focus, and Lumian’s figure reflected in his closed eye.
target: Lato Guiaro attentionem amisit, et imaginem Lumiani in oculo suo clauso vidit.

source: With the intent to annoy, he spoke his last words in Highlander.
target: Causa vexandi, ultimas verba in lingua Highlander locutus est.

source: “I’ve been there… with Mad Lady. It was… simply for fun… but Loki… seemed to… have ulterior…”
target: “Ibi fui… cum Mad Lady. Erat… simpliciter ad ludum… sed Loki… videbatur… ulteriores habere…”

source: Don’t you want to know what happened back then?
target: Nonne vis scire quid tunc acciderit?

source: Sure, I’ll speak in Highlander.
target: Certo, in lingua Highlander loquar.

source: It’s your problem if you don’t understand.
target: Tuum est problema, si non intellegis.

source: Your fault for not taking this language seriously in the past!
target: Culpa tua est quod hanc linguam prius non graviter accepisti!

source: Lato Guiaro knew his actions wouldn’t practically affect Lumian Lee.
target: Lato Guiaro sciebat actus suos prorsus Lumian Lee non afficere.

source: This was because Lumian Lee could find someone to perform dream divination, hypnosis, or undergo a real dream when he returned.
target: Hoc enim erat, quia Lumian Lee invenire poterat aliquem qui oneiromantiam, hypnotismum, aut verum somnium peragere posset, cum rediret.

source: From there, he could memorize the Highlander he spoke and find a way to translate it into Intisian or ancient Feysac.
target: Unde, poterat linguam Highlander quam locutus erat meminisse et viam invenire ut eam in Intisian vel antiquam Feysac transferret.

source: Still, he just wanted to annoy the other party.
target: Tamen, solum alterum vexare volebat.

source: About to die, he couldn’t care less about future developments.
target: Mox moriturus, futuris evenimentis nihil curabat.

source: “Motives…” Lato Guiaro uttered his last word as his life extinguished.
target: “Causae…” Lato Guiaro ultimum verbum edixit, cum vita eius extinguebatur.

source: In that final moment, he seemed to hear Lumian Lee speaking to him in Highlander, “Thank you.”
target: Illo momento finali, videbatur eum audire Lumian Lee, qui in lingua Highlander ad eum loquebatur, “Gratias.”

source: The “thank you” flowed naturally, carrying a strong sense of mockery.
target: Ille “gratias” naturaliter effluit, vehementem derisionis sensum ferens.

source: Ultraman Lato Guiaro’s intact eye bulged even more, his expression freezing on his face, his breath coming to a complete halt.
target: Oculus Ultraman Lato Guiaro intactus etiam magis protrudebat, vultus eius in facie immotus, et spiritus eius omnino cessavit.

source: Lumian’s right hand gripped the Symphony of Hatred once more.
target: Dextera manus Lumiani iterum Symphonia Odii tenuit.

source: Simultaneously, he released his left hand, watching Ultraman’s key member’s head rapidly detach from the black bone flute with red holes, revealing a sinister and deep blood-red hole.
target: Simul, sinistram manum dimisit, spectans caput membri principali Ultraman celeriter se ab instrumento ossi nigri cum foraminibus rubris separari, revelans sinus malignus et altus, rubro sanguineus.

source: Thud!
target: Tum!

source: Ultraman collapsed to the ground.
target: Ultraman in terram corruit.

source: The sticky blood on the black bone flute coalesced and dripped onto his body.
target: Sanguis viscosus in flauto ossi nigri coalescit et in corpus eius stillavit.

source: After the person who had backstabbed it suffered a fatal wound, Pride Armor stopped moving and stood nearby, resembling an ordinary silver-white full-body armor without any special characteristics.
target: Postquam ille, qui prodidit, vulnerum fatalium affectus est, “Pride Armor” motum desiit et prope stetit, similis armatura totius corporis argenteo-albae, nulla speciali nota.

source: Loki had ulterior motives? A motive other than helping the Sinners and pulling a prank?
target: Loki habebat ulteriores causas? Causa alia quam peccatoribus auxilio ferendo et iocum faciendo?

source: As Lumian recalled Ultraman’s confession before his death, he bent down to check what items this April Fool’s key member had.
target: Cum Lumian confessionem Ultramanis ante mortem revocavit, se inclinavit ad perscrutandum quae bona haberet hic membrum clavis “April Fool’s”.

source: Of course, he didn’t hold much hope.
target: Certe, parvam spem habebat.

source: Ultraman Lato Guiaro had disguised himself as the incoming Governor of the Sea, Simon Guiaro, to board the betrothal ship.
target: Ultraman Lato Guiaro se subdole indutus erat ut venturus Praefectus Maris, Simon Guiaro, ad navem sponsalem conscenderet.

source: Carrying no items, his belongings should have been handed over to Mad Lady, allowing her to conceal them using flesh and blood magic in his stomach.
target: Nihil ferens, supellectilia eius tradita esse debebant Mad Lady, ut illa ea celaret utens magia carnis et sanguinis in ventre eius.

source: However, Mad Lady clearly didn’t have the time or opportunity to return the items to Ultraman.
target: Attamen, Mad Lady manifeste tempus nec occasionem habuit ut supellectilia ad Ultraman redirent.

source: This was one of the reasons why Lumian could eliminate Ultraman, a powerful dual pathway Beyonder, in such a short period.
target: Hoc erat una ex causis cur Lumian Ultraman, potentem Beyonder duplicis viae, in tam brevi tempore exterminare posset.

source: If Juan Oro hadn’t tipped off the sea spawn on the bridal boat beforehand, Lumian would’ve been forced to stash his Traveler’s Bag temporarily with Mr. K.
target: Si Juan Oro non praemonuisset progenies marinas in nave sponsali, Lumian coactus fuisset ut sacculum Viatoris suum pro tempore apud Domine K reposeret.

source: At that moment, Lumian observed a strange transformation in the corpse of Ultraman Lato Guiaro.
target: Illo momento, Lumian transformationem insolitam in cadavere Ultraman Lato Guiaro observavit.

source: It swiftly faded, morphing into a semi-translucent, semi-flesh state.
target: Celeriter evanuit, transformans se in statum semi-translucidum et semi-carnosum.

source: Then, like it was being disintegrated by countless tiny creatures, it oozed into the silver metal floor and gradually vanished.
target: Deinde, quasi a innumeris parvulis creaturis dissolveretur, exsudavit in pavimentum metallicum argenteum et paulatim evanuit.

source: Soon, the remnants of flesh, starlight, and sun-like fragments left by Lato Guiaro were absorbed by the silver metallic floor, leaving behind only a Sea Governor ceremonial robe, shrouded in a faint grayish-white fog.
target: Mox, reliquiae carnis, lucis sideralis, et fragmenta solis similia ab Lato Guiaro relictae ab pavimento metallico argenteo absorptae sunt, relinquentes tantum vestem caerimonialem Praefecti Maris, tenuiter cinereo-albae nebulae involutam.

source: In the blink of an eye, the grayish-white fog got absorbed by the silver metallic floor and the mysterious structure.
target: In momento, nebula cinereo-albae ab pavimento metallico argenteo ac structura mysteriosa absorpta est.

source: Lumian attempted unsuccessfully to “reclaim” something.
target: Lumian conatus est aliquid “recuperare”, sed frustra.

source: Is this what it means to return to the sea?
target: Hocne est quod significat ad mare redire?

source: But why did this peculiar structure absorb the Priest of Light’s Beyonder characteristic?
target: Sed cur haec structura peculiaris proprietatem Beyonder Sacerdotis Lucis absoruit?

source: Just as Lumian pondered, the sound of metal grinding surrounded him.
target: Ita ut Lumian meditaret, strepitus metalli fricantis eum circumdedit.

source: The pitch-black holes in the surrounding walls, ceiling, and floor once again got concealed by rotating, protruding metal.
target: Foramina nigerrima in parietibus, laquearibus, et pavimento circumstantibus iterum absconsa sunt ab metallo rotante et protrudente.

source: No more cerulean-blue poisonous gas spewed out, saving Lumian the energy to engulf his body in a layer of crimson, almost white flames.
target: Nullus amplius gas venenosa caeruleo-azurea efflatus est, servans Luminum energiam ad corpus suum in strato flammarum carminarum, paene albarum involvendum.

source: Amidst the clanking sounds, two metallic doors ascended, revealing two tunnels leading to different destinations.
target: Inter sonos tintinnantes, duo ianuas metallicas surrexerunt, ostendentes duo cuniculos ad diversa loca ducere.

source: With the target of the betrayal now gone, the silver-gray behemoth reverted to its “normal” state.
target: Cum obiectum proditionis iam evanuerat, ingens argenteo-cineraceus monstrum ad statum suum “normalem” rediit.

source: Lumian peered into the depths of the tunnel ahead, his heart involuntarily racing.
target: Lumian in profundum cuniculi ante se intuebat, et cor eius involuntarie vehementer pulsabat.

source: Badump! Badump! He felt inexplicably nervous and uneasy.
target: Badump! Badump! Sine causa anxius et inquietus se sensit.

source: In Port Santa, the apartment Loki was hiding.
target: In Port Santa, in apartamento in quo Loki se abscondit.

source: The moment Ludwig declared, “I’m hungry,” he swiftly bowed his head and sank his teeth into Loki’s hand, gripping the gemstone bracelet as if devouring the marrow from a chicken wing.
target: Illo momento, Ludwig dixerit “Esurio,” celeriter caput inclinavit et dentes suos in manum Loki immerit, gemmatis bracchiale tenens, quasi medullam ex ala gallinae devorans.

source: An intense wave of pain surged through Loki’s mind.
target: Intensa unda doloris per mentem Loki pertransiit.

source: His immediate instinct was to deploy Paper Figurine Substitutes, a desperate attempt to break free from the current situation.
target: Instinctus immediatus eius erat “Paper Figurine Substitutes” adhibere, conatus desperatus ut e hac re se liberaret.

source: Yet, he hesitated, fearing that such a move might create an insurmountable distance between him and the sealed demigod, eliminating any chance of regaining control.
target: Tamen cunctavit, metuens ne talis motus spatium insuperabile inter se et demideum clausum crearet, tollens omnem facultatem regiminis recuperandi.

source: Amidst the gruesome symphony of bones crunching and flesh tearing, Loki snatched the falling gemstone bracelet with his free hand and forcibly pried open his mouth.
target: Inter horribilem symphoniam ossium confractarum et carnis dilaniatae, Loki bracchiale gemmatis cadens manu libera arripuit et vi os suum aperuit.

source: Bang!
target: Bang!

source: A rush of air slammed into Ludwig’s head, akin to a bullet fired from the latest steam rifle, ripping through flesh and hair to reveal a ghastly white skull.
target: Impulsus aeris in caput Ludovici verberavit, instar telae ex recentissimo tormento vaporario emissae, percurrens carnem et pilos, calvariam horridam albam revelans.

source: However, Ludwig remained unfazed.
target: Attamen, Ludwig immotus manebat.

source: Gnawing on Loki’s left hand, he had already severed five fingers and devoured half of the palm.
target: Mordens manum sinistram Loki, iam quinque digitos abscidit et dimidium palmae devoravit.

source: Bang! Bang! Bang! Air Bullets relentlessly pounded the boy, leaving him mangled and disfigured.
target: Bang! Bang! Bang! Projectilia aerea pertinaciter puero percusserunt, eum miserrime dilaniatum et deformatum relinquentes!

source: Yet, Ludwig persisted in his attentive nibbling on Loki.
target: Sed Ludwig perseveravit in sua diligenti morsa in Loki.

source: Crack, crack.
target: Crep, crep.

source: He had already crunched down on the other party’s wrist bone, a crisp sound echoing through their intertwined flesh.
target: Iam os carpale alterius partis conterebat, sonus crispus per carnem eorum implicatam resonans.

source: As Loki nearly blacked out from the pain, he roughly grasped what was happening.
target: Dum Loki paene ex dolore obscurabatur, aspera manu intellexit quid accideret.

source: The sealed demigod possessed incredible vitality.
target: Demideus clausus incredibilem vim vitalem possidebat.

source: Ordinary attacks and Beyonder powers couldn’t cause significant harm.
target: Impulsus ordinarii et facultates Beyonder damnum grave creare non poterant.

source: In simpler terms, he could put him to sleep or manipulate his Spirit Body Threads to knock him out, but killing him with regular means proved challenging.
target: Simpliciter, eum ad dormiendum inducere poterat aut fila corporis spiritus eius regere ut illum incoscientem redderet, sed eum ordinariis modis occidere difficile erat.

source: In such circumstances, even if the sealed demigod couldn’t utilize any abilities, lacking sufficient strength and speed, merely devouring the other party’s flesh and bones with all his might posed an abnormal challenge for many Mid-Sequence Beyonders.
target: In talibus condicionibus, etiam si demideus clausus ullam facultatem adhibere non posset, carens vi et celeritate sufficienti, sola edendo carnem et ossa alterius partis omni sua potentia, provocationem insolitam pluribus Beyonder Medi-sequentibus constituit.

source: Loki abandoned the idea of retrieving other mystical items and substituted himself with a paper figurine.
target: Loki consilium reliquorum mysticorum rerum recuperandi reliquit et se substituit figurina papyracea.

source: Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Ludwig, his head covered in signs of Air Bullet destruction and almost devoid of human form, raised his head.
target: Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Ludwig, capite suo signis destructae aeris telae et paene forma humana carens, caput attollit.

source: Beside his bloodstained mouth was a piece of white paper that quickly swept into his mouth alongside the blood-colored flesh.
target: Ad os eius, quod sanguine tinctum erat, erat frustum papyri albi, quod celeriter in os eius traiecit, simul cum carne sanguine colorata.

source: Ludwig’s eyes reflected Loki’s outline in the corner of the room.
target: Oculi Ludovici contornum Loki in angulo conclavi reflexerunt.

source: Something beneath his torn skin and flesh seemed to squirm slowly, attempting to break free, but to no avail.
target: Aliquid sub cute lacerata et carne eius lente contorquebatur, conans se liberare, sed frustra.

source: Loki assessed the situation and the items on him.
target: Loki condicionem et res in se aestimavit.

source: With the Soul Assurer marionette unable to return in time, he sensibly chose not to confront the sealed demigod creature.
target: Cum “Soul Assurer” marionetta tempore redeundi non posset, sapienter elegit non pugnare contra creaturam demidei clausi.

source: He would flee first before considering the future.
target: Primum fugiturus erat antequam futura consideraret.

source: At that moment, a crimson moonlight streamed through the window.
target: Illo momento, lumen lunaris rubrum per fenestram effluebat.

source: The moonlight bathed the apartment, wrapping around Loki.
target: Lumen lunaris apartamentum perfudit, circumvolvens Loki.

source: Loki heard a fleeting voice.
target: Loki audivit vocem evanescentem.

source: “A strong smell of blood…”
target: “Odor intensus sanguinis…”

source: As the moonlight faded, a grayish-white and pitch-black paper figurine appeared on the ground.
target: Dum lumen lunaris evanuit, figurina papyracea cinereo-alba et nigerrima in terra apparuit.

source: Loki’s figure materialized a few hundred meters away, outside a vine forest.
target: Figura Loki paucos centena passuum distante, extra lucum vitarum, apparuit.

source: It was a boon bestowed by the Celestial Worthy during a prayer some weeks before this operation.
target: Erat donum concessum a Caelestibus Dignis per preces aliquot hebdomadarum ante hanc operationem.

source: It had been attached to a pre-prepared paper figurine, forming such a potent substitute that bordered on godhood.
target: Illud ad figurinam papyraceam praeparatam adnexus erat, formans substitutum tam potentem ut ad deitatem propinquum esset.

source: Drip, drip. Blood still dripped from Loki’s bitten left wrist.
target: Gutta, gutta. Sanguis adhuc ex carpo sinistro, quem Loki mordebat, stillabat.

source: He activated the diamond on the bracelet and swiftly faded away, preparing to teleport.
target: Adamas in bracchiale activavit et celeriter evanuit, se teleportare parans.

source: Port Santa, Milo Village.
target: Port Santa, Vicus Milo.

source: Tap, tap, tap.
target: Tac, tac, tac.

source: The soft patter of footsteps reverberated in Bard’s ears, causing him to tense.
target: Mollis strepitus vestigiorum in auribus Bardi resonabat, eum tensum faciens.

source: Bard surveyed his surroundings, finding nothing amiss.
target: Bard circumstantia sua perspexit, nihil inusitatum inveniens.

source: He sprinted, weaving through several buildings, yet the rhythmic tapping of footsteps persisted behind him.
target: Cucurrit, inter varia aedificia serpens, sed strepitus vestigiorum rhythmice post eum perseverabat.

source: Attempting to force open a door and seek refuge in a villager’s house in Milo Village,
target: Tentans ostium forare et in domo vicani in Vicus Milo refugium petere,

source: Bard was met with an unexpected sight.
target: Bard spectaculum inopinatum invenit.

source: Instead of the familiar kitchen, tables, chairs, and household items, his eyes beheld a decrepit stone platform enveloped in darkness.
target: Pro coquina nota, mensis, sellis, et supellectilibus domesticis, oculi eius conspectum invenerunt vetustum tabulatum lapideum, in tenebris involutum.

source: The stone platform!
target: Tabulatum lapideum!

source: Bard’s pupils widened, as if he had entered an unreal illusion.
target: Pupillae Bardi dilatatae sunt, quasi in illusionem incredibilem intravisset.

source: He found himself back at the residence of the Governor of the Sea and the altar where Milo Village’s inhabitants paid homage to their ancestor.
target: Inventus est se iterum in domicilio Praefecti Maris et in altare, ubi incolae Vicus Milo maioribus suis honorem afferebant.

source: Something crawled out from a crack in the worn stone platform.
target: Aliquid ex fissura in vetusto tabulato lapideo emerguit.

source: A translucent worm, adorned with multiple rings, swiftly expanded, transforming into a young man donned in the attire of a sea prayer ritual’s deputy host, monocle in place.
target: Vermis translucidus, multis anulis ornatus, celeriter dilatatus est, transformatus in iuvenem, qui indutus erat vestitu hospitis vicarii ritus orationis maris, cum monoculo in oculo dextro.

source: Seated on the weathered stone platform, the man grinned at Bard.
target: Sedens in tabulato lapideo vetusto, vir Bard subridens aspexit.

source: “Do you comprehend?”
target: “Intelligis?”

source: Bard suddenly grasped the meaning behind the question.
target: Bard subito quaestionis significationem intellexit.

source: Swallowing hard, he replied, “Understood.”
target: Durius deglutiens, respondit, “Intellexi.”

source: Since the altar had an owner and Beyonder creatures residing there, the so‐called rule that it could only be enchanted once a year for the Ring of the Sea Queen clearly didn’t hold true!
target: Cum altare dominum haberet et ibi creaturae Beyonder habitabant, regula, quae dicebatur se solum semel in anno pro Anulo Reginae Maris incantari posse, plane non validum erat!

source: The other party could affix the power as many times as desired!
target: Alter pars potestatem, quoties vellet, adicere poterat!

source: The young man, clad in a dark-blue deputy host’s sacrificial robe, toyed with the monocle in his right eye and smirked.
target: Iuvenis, in veste sacrificatoria hospitis vicarii caeruleo obscuro indutus, ludebatur cum monoculo in oculo dextro et subridens arridebat.

source: “Over a millennium, I’ve molded the rule that the Steal ability can only be conferred once a year. Little did I expect to deceive you all in the end.”
target: “Per plus mille annos, regulam condidi, ut facultas Furtum solum semel in anno conferretur. Parum fere exspectavi ut vos omnes tandem deciperem.”
